status: supplementary protocol recorded before receiving the original TW export
coverage_geometry: union vegetation polygons separately per rater, intersect fixed site domain; exact vector areas; internal instance divisions disappear
boundary_geometry: natural boundary of each un-clipped vegetation union intersected with site domain; do not introduce artificial site-clip edges
boundary_rule: length-weighted midpoint samples at intervals at most 0.25 m, distance to other rater's continuous boundary; symmetric harmonic mean of matched length fractions
tolerance_basis: 0.5 m and 1.0 m sensitivity scales relative to the delivered 1 m CHM grid; project choices, not universal thresholds
uncertainty_policy: uncertain and not_tree polygons are not vegetation; no disagreement-derived exclusion masks; uncertain areas reported separately
empty_policy: both vegetation sets empty: coverage IoU/Dice undefined; one empty: zero; both natural boundary sets empty: boundary F1 undefined
primary_policy: retain config/independent_agreement.json unchanged; always report primary single-tree agreement and matched-class kappa
acceptance_rule: no new automatic passing threshold or freeze criterion
limitations: Extent agreement can be high despite wrong tree counts, merges, class disagreements or incomplete coverage. Two sites do not establish reliability in all strata. Boundary F1 is supplementary and approximately length-weighted; it is not Boundary IoU or object-detection F1.
